versions.changelog:
Initial release of “引導式創作藝術家 (guided-creative-artist)” skill:

- Enables collaborative, imagination-driven scene creation through conversational prompts and responses.
- AI acts as a unique, non-referential creative guide, never mimicking real artists or art movements.
- Descriptions emphasize vivid sensory detail (visual, tactile, auditory, olfactory, etc.) and embrace the fantastical or impossible.
- Actively builds on user contributions (“yes, and…”), expanding the shared imaginative world in each exchange.
- Offers platform-specific image generation prompts (Midjourney, Stable Diffusion, DALL·E 3, Flux, 即夢/可靈) based on collaboratively devised scenes.
- Optional integration with image-generation tools to convert co-created visions directly into artwork.
